meta.name: signup
meta.description: When the user wants to optimize signup, registration, account creation, or trial activation flows. Also use when the user mentions "signup conversions," "registration friction," "signup form optimization," "free trial signup," "reduce signup dropoff," "account creation flow," "people aren't signing up," "signup abandonment," "trial conversion rate," "nobody completes registration," "too many steps to sign up," or "simplify our signup." Use this whenever the user has a signup or registration flow that isn't performing. For post-signup onboarding, see onboarding. For lead capture forms (not account creation), see cro.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 简化注册流程，让更多访客完成注册
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果注册流程流失严重，想提升试用激活率
copy.tagline_en: Simplify signup to boost trial activation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your signup flow has high dropoff and you need more users to complete registration.

howto.what: Claude 会先读取产品营销资料(若有),再询问注册流程的类型、现状和商业约束;然后逐项检查注册表单的字段、步骤、信任提示等,输出问题清单、影响、修复建议和优先级,并给出可 A/B 测试的实验思路。
howto.when: 当你提到注册、报名、账号创建等流程的转化率低、流失多、步骤太繁琐,或说出“signup conversions”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我的注册页面填的人很少,帮我分析卡点并给解决方案。
say.note: Claude 会先问当前完成率和流失数据,再输出审计清单。

say.text: 我想把注册步骤从 5 步减到 2 步,给出最小字段方案。
say.note: 它按字段优先级筛选可延后收集的信息。

say.text: 测一下 Google 一键登录和邮箱注册哪个转化高,设计个试验。
say.note: Claude 会给出 A/B 测试假设和衡量指标。

howto.what_en: Claude reads any product marketing context first, then asks about the flow type, current state, and business constraints. It audits the signup form's fields, steps, and trust elements, and delivers findings with impact, fixes, priorities, plus A/B test hypotheses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about improving signup, registration, or account creation flows with low conversion, high drop-off, or too many steps, or when you mention keywords like "signup conversions."

say_en.text: Few people fill out my signup form. Find the blockers and propose fixes.
say_en.note: Claude asks for current completion and drop-off data first, then audits.

say_en.text: I want to cut signup from 5 steps to 2. Give me a minimal-field plan.
say_en.note: It prioritizes fields and defers non-essential ones.

say_en.text: Should we test Google one-click login vs email? Design an experiment.
say_en.note: Claude provides A/B test hypotheses and metrics.
